svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 20.2 mm of 12 mm aluminium tube (8.5 mm bore, or drill

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bore out to 8.5 mm). Face both ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It fills the gap between the back of the bracket plate and the pole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at the through-bolt, so tightening the bolt does not bend the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File the pole end to a shallow curve if it rocks on the pole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the M8 through-bolt between the plate and the pole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: length 20.2 mm, within 0.5 mm; on a 60 mm pole the plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stays flat when the bolt is tight.
